description: As per police, scammers are now employing AI-based techniques to implement voice cloning on a victim’s family member or acquaintance on call.
body_lead: The Cyber Crime Wing of the Tamil Nadu police has issued an advisory cautioning the public against fraudsters who are using artificial intelligence-based voice cloning techniques to scam people over phone calls, according to a report by The Hindu. What is the modus operandi of the scammers? According to a press note shared with MediaNama by the TN police Cyber department, scammers are now employing AI-based techniques to impersonate a victim’s family member or acquaintance on call and deceive them into transferring money claiming an emergency.
